```python
def apply_edits(text, edits):
    """Apply non-overlapping [start, end, replacement] edits to text.
    Indices are code-point offsets into the original text, 0 <= start <= end <= len(text).
    Edits are valid, non-overlapping, and sorted by start. Same-start edits are excluded.
    Edits are applied simultaneously using half-open intervals; start == end inserts.
    The original text is not mutated.
    """
    result_parts = []
    prev = 0
    for start, end, replacement in edits:
        result_parts.append(text[prev:start])
        result_parts.append(replacement)
        prev = end
    result_parts.append(text[prev:])
    return ''.join(result_parts)
```
